reader.requirement: At --std 85 every record description of one sequential FD must occupy the same record area (an implicit redefinition, left-aligned), so after a READ (and at any other time) each description sees the bytes of the current record; positions beyond the current record's length are undefined and may hold anything.
reader.edition-search: grep Edition/CobolVersion/DialectBehavior in SequentialIoEmitter.cs, ClassifyRedefinesClassesPass.cs and FileControlBinder.FileSection.cs#LinkImplicitRecordArea: only binder.Edition.Error/At (the diagnostic sink, not a switch) and SelectWhenOnlyForFilePhraseStatements (a SELECT WHEN path a plain FD does not take)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f22_01 and pb5729 use records of equal length and alphanumeric/display numeric fields; records of different lengths, binary and edited items, an OCCURS DEPENDING record and aliasing without I/O are not exercised

probes.printed: NOIO RA=3ABC RO-N=3 RO-T3=C RQ-X=3A / R1 RA=ABCD RB=ABCDEFGH RQ-Y=CDEFGH / R2 RA=WXYZ RB(1:4)=WXYZ FS=00 / R3 RC-N=+0258 W2N=+0258 RC-E= 12.50 RB(3:6)= 12.50 / R4 RO-N=4 RO=4PQRS RA=4PQR RB(1:5)=4PQRS / EOF 10
probes.expected: all five descriptions alias one left-aligned area: a MOVE to RB is seen through RA, RQ and the ODO record RO with no I/O; after each READ every description shows the record's bytes (COMP bytes verbatim, edited item verbatim, ODO record by its count); bytes beyond a short record are undefined

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.4.4 GR6  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6

reader.notes: LinkImplicitRecordArea makes every record with a character window an implicit redefinition of the first; an out-of-line record (the ODO group) shares the area at the transfer boundary, and the probe shows it aliases even without I/O. EmitImageInto stores the read image verbatim into a shared area (VerbatimStorageArea), so binary items are not re-encoded. No edition switch on the path.

refuter.evidence: q3a.cob (runs/q3a-002): three record descriptions in one FD: RA (USAGE INDEX item, S9(3) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE, X(4) JUSTIFIED RIGHT), RB (4 x X(4)), RC (X OCCURS 16 INDEXED BY). No I/O: saving RB, changing RA-IX/RA-S, restoring RB brings back IX=05 S=-042 J='  AB' (the index item lives in the shared area); SEARCH over RC finds the separate sign at position 9 (behind the 8-byte index item). After READ, R1 IX=05 S=-042; after saving record 2 through RB and an AT END READ, restoring RB gives IX=03 S=+123 J=' XYZ'. Every description aliases the one area, including an index data item and a JUSTIFIED item. Citation: OK §1985:VII.4.4.4 GR6 (the text is in GR6).
